title: Positive density gives a uniform lower density-ratio bound for 0 < ρ ≤ 1/(k+1)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, x ∈ ℝ^N and t ∈ [0, ∞] with t > 0 (t = ∞ allowed). Suppose HasDensity n μ x t, i.e. densityRatio n μ x ρ = μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) → t as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the closed ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n (so ω_0 = 1), and the quotient is taken in [0, ∞]. Then there are m, k ∈ ℕ such that (2(m + 1))⁻¹ ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ in [0, ∞] for every real ρ with 0 < ρ ≤ 1/(k + 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < t → HasDensity n μ x t → ∃ m k : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → (2 * ((m : ℝ≥0∞) + 1))⁻¹ ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ
